title: Diverging Likert responses
intent: Compare response distributions across survey questions around a shared zero baseline.

ai.create: Create a diverging Likert chart from typed {question, response, signedValue} rows, stacking disagreement left of zero and neutral or agreement right of zero.
ai.maintain: Reorder response categories while preserving Plot stack semantics, granular d3-shape diverging offsets, stable colors, and inferred categorical keys.
